title: Pebble vibration alarms not working
body:
I would expect that the Pebble watch would vibrate in case of alarms triggered by the Watchface. But this is not the case. Tried the booth graph whatchfaces with vibrate setting on. 
System Android 7.1.2 (SlimRom 7) on a OnePlus One. PebbleTime. latest Nightly of xDrip+ installed. 
May not importend, but using blueReader from Sandra with Libre. LimmiTTer interface.

comments.body:
After checking some settings, I see that the notifications for xDrip itself was off in the Pebble-Configuration-App. It seems, that the setting in xDrip alone is not enough. After switching it the vibration works nicely. May a notice in the App should be placed that also in the Pebble-Config the notification has to be turned on.
This issue could be set to fixed (or whatever right named status;) )
